prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "förolämpa". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "offend".
Scene: Two adults in conversation, one choosing words carefully with an apologetic open-hand gesture while the other looks slightly hurt; a crossed-out jagged speech symbol represents an insult without any rude readable text.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "förolämpa = offend or insult someone.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jag vill inte förolämpa dig.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
